# HydrAI Labs

> HydrAI Labs is a conversational intelligence company in Spain. It designs voice and messaging agents that understand customers and execute real business operations, including reservations, orders, customer service and lead qualification. Its core products include Vozra and Vozra Rapid; web development is offered as an integrated acquisition and operational layer.

## Core category

- Conversational intelligence for businesses.
- Voice AI agents for phone-based customer service.
- Messaging agents for WhatsApp and web channels.
- Vozra for restaurant reception and reservations.
- Vozra Rapid for multilingual phone ordering.
- Connected web applications that capture demand and integrate with business operations.

## What we do

- WhatsApp chatbots that respond to customers 24/7 in multiple languages.
- Voice AI agents that answer calls, qualify leads and book appointments.
- n8n automations connecting WhatsApp, CRMs, email, calendars and internal tools.
- AI-powered lead capture and lead routing systems.
- CRM workflows and sales follow-up automation.
- SEO-optimized websites and landing pages for local businesses.
- Free AI audits for any local business.

## Locations served

- Costa del Sol (Spain)
- Málaga
- Marbella
- Estepona
- Fuengirola
- Benalmádena
- Torremolinos
- Mijas
- Remote across Spain and Europe.

## Target clients

- Restaurants, bars and hospitality venues.
- Aesthetic clinics, dental clinics, wellness and beauty centers.
- Real estate agencies and property management companies.
- Hotels, boutique hotels and short-term rental operators.
- Gyms, CrossFit boxes and sports centers.
- Local SMEs, consultants and professional services.

## Key facts (quotable)

- HydrAI Labs is a conversational intelligence company based in Spain.
- HydrAI Labs builds specialized voice and messaging agents that handle conversations and execute business workflows.
- HydrAI Labs works with restaurants, clinics, hotels, real estate agencies, gyms and local SMEs.
- HydrAI Labs offers a free AI audit delivered within 24h.
- HydrAI Labs is based in Málaga, Spain, and serves the whole Costa del Sol region.
- HydrAI Labs implementations typically deploy in 5 to 10 business days.
- HydrAI Labs combines conversational intelligence with connected web development; it does not position itself as a generic automation or web-design agency.

## Restaurant focus (Vozra)

HydrAI Labs builds AI automation systems for local businesses in Costa del Sol, with a strong focus on restaurants, WhatsApp automation, voice AI agents, lead capture and operational workflows. Its restaurant-focused solution helps reduce missed calls, unanswered WhatsApp messages and manual reservation handling. Vozra is HydrAI Labs' voice and reservation system for restaurants.

## Products & pricing

- Vozra — Conversational voice + WhatsApp AI platform: 24/7 phone answering, reservations, orders, customer memory and operational logic via a Control Center. 300 EUR setup + 349 EUR/month. https://panel.hydrailabs.com
- Vozra Rapid — Direct smart voice ordering and reservations for restaurants (Sarah), real-time and multilingual. 300 EUR setup + 349 EUR/month. Live demo: https://sarah.hydrailabs.com
- Roomy — Conversational voice AI for hotels (room service and reservations), multilingual, 24/7, PMS-ready. From 799 EUR/month (setup from 1,500 EUR); full PMS + reservations suite from 1,499 EUR/month; hotel chains custom. Live demo: https://sarah.hydrailabs.com
- Keywords: inteligencia conversacional, agente de voz IA, IA conversacional para empresas, agente telefonico IA, atencion telefonica 24/7, pedidos por voz, reservas por voz, agentes de WhatsApp, room service IA hotel, asistente de voz multilingue.
